sample_unit: guideline recommendations translated into clinical questions (each submitted 3 times)

links.outcome: Textual consistency of ChatGPT-4o responses across three repeated independent sessions
links.effect: Internal text consistency across repeated trials was low, with several responses showing unacceptable similarity levels (<50%).
links.quote: Internal text consistency across repeated trials was low, with several responses showing unacceptable similarity levels (<50%).

links.outcome: Concordance of ChatGPT-4o answers with AAOS knee arthroplasty guideline recommendations
links.effect: Overall concordance of 60% with CPG recommendations, fair agreement (κ = 0.392, p = 0.005); discrepancies persisted in functional outcomes and rehabilitation recommendations.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o achieved an overall concordance of 60% with the CPG recommendations, representing fair agreement (κ = 0.392, p = 0.005).

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT-4o's alignment with clinical practice guidelines for knee osteoarthritis surgical management using structured test queries.
